hero_headline: AI selloff meets blue-wave scrutiny as chip multiples and data-center buildouts face a stress test
daily_overview: Global markets are repricing AI infrastructure risk after a Democratic sweep of Congress raised the probability of tougher scrutiny for data-center construction. US futures rebounded Friday as dip buyers emerged, but the underlying gauges had already sold off sharply, and the weakness spread to Asia and Europe. Chip valuations are in focus: a screen of 14 semiconductor stocks shows forward P/E ranging from 71x at ARM to 3.5x at SNDK, while trailing free cash flow tells a different story. In credit, European corporate bonds have been shielded from the equity rout by windfalls on AI-related debt deals from Meta and Alphabet. New York Fed President John Williams said it is a good time to gather more data on price risks, signaling no rush on policy. Politics adds noise: hoax bomb threats have disrupted European flights, Paraguay’s president was impeached minutes after resigning amid a digital-bank collapse, and Ukraine is watching the US midterms for signs of a shift in peace negotiations. The common thread is that AI capex, election outcomes, and security risks are now trading together.

tech_briefs.title: Tweet draft: Chip forward P/E vs. trailing FCF after selloff
tech_briefs.summary: Forward P/E on 14 chip stocks ranges from 71x at ARM to 3.5x at SNDK, but forward earnings is not what the price needs. Trailing free cash flow vs. market cap is the cleaner stress test after the selloff. Not financial advice. Views are my own.

tech_briefs.title: Tweet draft: Data-center scrutiny and business-line impact
tech_briefs.summary: If post-election scrutiny slows data-center permits, the revenue hit lands on power, cooling, and networking backlogs before it shows up in AI model launches. Evidence: Texas was the fastest-growing US data center market and ground zero for Big Tech buildouts, and that position is now at risk. Not financial advice. Views are my own.

tech_briefs.title: Tweet draft: Dip-buying question for US traders
tech_briefs.summary: US futures are bouncing after the AI selloff, but the Nasdaq is still below pre-election levels. Are you buying semis here or waiting for data-center capex guidance? Full breakdown link in my bio. Not financial advice. Views are my own.

finance_briefs.title: Global equities fall as AI slowdown fears spread to Asia and Europe
finance_briefs.summary: Global stocks fell as investors weighed possible tougher scrutiny of data-center construction and the AI industry after a Democratic sweep of Congress. The selloff spread from the US to Asia and Europe, with investors worried that Democratic dominance could slow the AI boom. (multiple reports)

finance_briefs.title: US stock futures rebound as dip buyers emerge after AI-driven selloff
finance_briefs.summary: US stock futures rebounded in a volatile session following a day of heavy selling in the underlying gauges. The bounce came after the Democratic sweep of Congress in the midterm elections and a sharp AI-led selloff.

finance_briefs.title: European credit shielded from tech rout by AI debt deal windfalls
finance_briefs.summary: The global technology rout has so far spared European corporate bonds. Windfalls on debt deals from Meta Platforms and Alphabet helped the market avoid the hammering taken by equities.

finance_briefs.title: Morgan Stanley cuts Coinbase revenue estimates, cites less certain earnings recovery
finance_briefs.summary: Morgan Stanley slashed revenue estimates for Coinbase and said confidence in the cryptocurrency exchange's earnings recovery is less certain. The bear case on Coinbase is growing.

politics_briefs.title: Hoax bomb threats disrupt European flights for second week
politics_briefs.summary: Hoax bomb threats targeted commercial flights across Europe this week, leaving at least 35 planes searched or diverted before Friday. A Romanian airline Tarom flight from Prague to Bucharest was the latest believed target.

politics_briefs.title: Paraguay president impeached minutes after resigning over bank collapse
politics_briefs.summary: Paraguayan lawmakers voted to impeach President Santiago Peña minutes after his resignation. The collapse of a digital bank tied to his government froze millions of people's savings.

politics_briefs.title: Ukraine sees guarded optimism in US midterm results
politics_briefs.summary: Ukrainian officials and commentators expressed guarded optimism that the Democratic victory in US midterms could alter the course of peace negotiations and the war nearing its fifth year.
